name: StdCheckerBot
description: High-Performance Concurrency Telegram HTTP, URL, Proxy, and Link Diagnostic Bot built in Go. Multi-threaded goroutine workers, SSL verification, latency tracking, and CSV/JSON report exports.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram Numeric User ID of the Bot Owner

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Connection String (MongoDB Atlas or standalone)

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Channel username to force users to join (without @)

LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel ID for audit logs (optional, e.g. -1001234567890)

MAX_CONCURRENT_CHECKS.description: Maximum parallel goroutine workers for bulk requests
